# StableFit

StableFit is an app and CRM for personal trainers: clients, workout programs, progress, nutrition, and chat in one place - instead of Excel and messengers.

It is for a solo personal trainer who runs their own clients.

It is not a gym booking system, studio till, membership CRM, group slot scheduler, or white-label brand.

Up to 3 clients are free. Then $20 per month or $100 per year through the App Store or Google Play, billed in local currency.
